note: B marks only unblock! optional, so init! and shutdown! read as required. §11.6 7919-7920 (D-366): "Of the four functions, only loop is mandatory. init!, shutdown! and unblock! are optional hooks, each defaulting to a no-op." Reserved word *contract*.

note: §11.6 7913 and 7924; §12.4 9073. "calling task" unlinked (#g-calling-task).

excerpt: That call is bracketed, so a throw there is `shutdown!` plus `DeviceCrash` by name
and the device is dead from the run's first frame top ([§12.4][s12-4]).
The author-owned task body runs inside the framework's try/catch/finally wrapper
and voluntary exit is returning ([§11.6][s11-6], [§12.4][s12-4]).

`running`, `latest`, `wait_next_snapshot` ([§12.3][s12-3]), `stage!`, `binding`, `gather`, `report!` ([§11.6][s11-6]), and `pending` ([§11.7][s11-7]).
